IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Kline, Esser, Johnson and Weinstein; by request of Washington Uniform Legislation Commission

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the effective date of the uniform interstate family support act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the uniform interstate family support act; andamending RCW 26.21A.900.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.21A.900 and 2002 c 198 s 906 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act takes effect ((six months after the amendment by congressto 42 U.S.C. Sec. 666(f) authorizing or mandating states to adopt thisversion of the uniform interstate family support act)) January 1, 2007.
